findings.description: Dorsal contour guide and elliptical sections do not represent cranial/maxillary supporting volumes; cannot serve as requested skull foundation.
Mandibular centerline lacks mandibular body depth, ascending ramus/coronoid and explicit articular support; articulation transform alone does not establish anatomy.
Authored breed profiles have not been validated against matched skull views; groomed Maltipoo silhouette is insufficient skeletal evidence.
